name: Interceptor Saber Design
description: The Interceptor Saber Design was a custom lightsaber hilt owned by the droid Hunter J-3DI that he could wield for the Hunters of the Outer Rim competition on Vespaara as an alternative to his standard lightsaber. It resembled the design of both the Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor and Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptors used by Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker shortly before the collapse of the Jedi Order.
